resources.string: Source preview builds need a configured public application Client ID for Microsoft sign-in. Enter an application ID approved for Minecraft authentication with public-client device code flow enabled. This is not a password or client secret. Leave blank to use the build default. Sign in to your Microsoft account again after changing it.

This source preview build has no Microsoft public application Client ID. Configure it in Settings → Launcher → Microsoft public application Client ID, then sign in again. You can use an existing offline account to test VR.
